title: A zoomed recording shows its ring on the frame, not handles off the edge
goal: When a recording is zoomed in and picked, the canvas outlines the whole magnified picture, so a dashed edge and a handle hang out past the frame on empty canvas. The zoom walkthrough puts a ring on the frame itself, which is where the shot is.
notes: Seen 2026-10-11 by a-zoomed-recording-s-motion-path-shows-where-the. Repro: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk.json, picture 3-framed-at-5-sc.png (copy queue/audits/2026-10-11-zoom-no-path-3-framed-at-5-sc.png): at 220% a dashed vertical line runs at about x=288 screen points left of the frame (frame left edge ~311) with a square handle at (288,633), the magnified layer box. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-zoom-wt.html #frameRing (step 5 on: the clip outlines on the timeline, a ring lands on the frame). Layer.takesAReframe / positionReadsAsCentre names the case. Resize handles on a zoomed clip may need a UX call (drag them to change Scale, or none): decision card if unsure.
acceptance: With a recording at 220% and picked, the outline sits on the edge of the frame, not outside it
No resize handle is drawn out on the empty canvas past the frame
A title or shape picked on top of the same recording keeps its usual outline and handles
A walk at Next defaults photographs the picked zoomed recording
